If you wish to address the City Council on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).

UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
CONSIDERATION OF AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR THE HANDICAPPED RAMPS AND SIDEWALKS PROJECT
It is recommended that the City Council award a contract in the amount of $78,295 to Gentry Brothers, Inc. for the installation of Handicapped Ramps and Sidewalks.

C-2
FOLLOW-UP REPORT REGARDING DISTANCING RESTRICTIONS PERTAINING TO ESTABLISHMENTS THAT SELL BEER, WINE, OR LIQUOR FOR OFF-SITE CONSUMPTION
It is recommended that the City Council review and discuss this report and direct Staff accordingly.

D.
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1314 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2011-12
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the Resolution approving Warrant Register No. 1314.
CC.D-1 Resoultion Warrant Register #1314
D-2
ADOPTION OF AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF LA PUENTE, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING SECTION 2.13 OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE RELATING TO EXCEPTIONS TO THE CIVIL SERVICE SYSTEM
It is recommended that the City Council Adopt Ordinance No. 12-921 of the City of La Puente, amending Section 2.13 of the La Puente Municipal code relating to exceptions of the Civil Service System.
CC.D-2 HR Report Civil Service Ordinance
CC.D-2 HR Report Civil Service Ordinance-Attachment A (Ordinance)
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF AWARD OF A CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT FOR THE TRAFFIC SIGNAL MODIFICATIONS AND INSTALLATION AT VARIOUS LOCATIONS PROJECT NO. HSIPL- 5531(010) AND HSIPL-5531(017)
It is recommended that the City Council 1) award the contract to California Professional Engineering, Inc. in the amount of $488,208.20 and 2) authorize the City Manager to approve change orders up to 10 % of the bid.
CC.D-3 Traffic Signal Modification and Installation Report
CC.D-3 Award La Puente Traffic Signal Project Agreement
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1314 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2011-12
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the Resolution approving Warrant Register No. 1314.
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF AWARD OF A CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT FOR THE TRAFFIC SIGNAL MODIFICATIONS AND INSTALLATION AT VARIOUS LOCATIONS PROJECT NO. HSIPL- 5531(010) AND HSIPL-5531(017)
It is recommended that the City Council 1) award the contract to California Professional Engineering, Inc. in the amount of $488,208.20 and 2) authorize the City Manager to approve change orders up to 10 % of the bid.
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH CAROL COWLEY TO PROVIDE ADDITIONAL SERVICES IN THE CITY CLERK'S OFFICE IN A FORM TO BE APPROVED BY THE INTERIM CITY ATTORNEY IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $25,000
It is recommended that the City Council approve entering into a professional services agreement with Carol Cowley to provide additional City Clerk services subject to approval by the Interim City Attorney in an amount not to exceed $25,000.
CC.E-1 Deputy City Clerk Professional Services Agreement
CC.E-1 Proposal by Intellibridge Partners Att A
CC.E-1 Proposal by Carol Cowley Att B
CC.E-1 Proposal by CCMS, Inc Att C
E-2
COUNCIL WORKSHOP AND TRAINING BY CAL JPIA ON COUNCIL RELATIONS AND MATTERS RELATED TO CAL JPIA's SERVICES TO THE CITY
It is recommended that the City Council adjourn tonight's meeting to continue consideration of this item to Monday, March 5, 2012 from 5:30 p.m. to 9:30 p.m., at the Senior Center Multi-Purpose Room.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk?s Office at (626) 855-1500.
